label: 4th generation: annual limit on manual and related therapies
appliesTo: 4th generation policyholders claiming manual therapy, extracorporeal shockwave or prolotherapy
why: The figure most quoted as though it described Korean indemnity insurance generally. It describes one generation's rider, and the fifth generation excludes several of these therapies from its non-severe cover altogether — so quoting it to someone buying a policy now is not a small inaccuracy but a description of a product they cannot buy.

history.source: Financial Services Commission — 4th generation non-covered rider limits
history.note: For manual therapy, extracorporeal shockwave and prolotherapy taken together. Alongside separate limits in the same rider for non-covered injections at ₩2,500,000 and 50 sessions, and non-covered MRI and MRA at ₩3,000,000. Session counts and cumulative claims have to be tracked together, since either can end cover for the year.
